<documents>
<document id="transfers-brookpay">
SendingˆmoneyˆwithˆBrookPayˆBrookPayˆletsˆyouˆsendˆmoneyˆtoˆanotherˆTallowbrookˆmemberˆbyˆphoneˆnumber,ˆemailˆorˆusername.ˆIt'sˆfree,ˆitˆworksˆeveryˆday,ˆandˆtheˆmoneyˆarrivesˆinˆseconds.ˆ##ˆSendˆmoneyˆTapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆBrookPay.ˆChooseˆtheˆperson,ˆenterˆtheˆamountˆandˆconfirm.ˆTheˆrecipientˆseesˆtheˆmoneyˆstraightˆaway.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆDailyˆBrookPayˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆForˆ24ˆhoursˆafterˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆandˆexternalˆtransfersˆareˆlimitedˆtoˆ$500.ˆ##ˆBrookPayˆcan'tˆbeˆreversedˆOnceˆaˆBrookPayˆpaymentˆisˆsent,ˆitˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆorˆpulledˆback,ˆevenˆbyˆsupport.ˆOnlyˆsendˆmoneyˆtoˆpeopleˆyouˆknow.ˆIfˆyouˆsentˆmoneyˆtoˆtheˆwrongˆperson,ˆaskˆthemˆtoˆsendˆitˆback.ˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆyouˆwereˆscammed,ˆreportˆitˆtoˆusˆrightˆaway.ˆ##ˆFeesˆBrookPayˆcostsˆ$0.00ˆonˆeveryˆplan.ˆBrookPayˆonlyˆworksˆbetweenˆTallowbrookˆmembers.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="transfers-cancel">
CancellingˆaˆtransferˆWhetherˆyouˆcanˆcancelˆaˆtransferˆdependsˆonˆtheˆtypeˆofˆtransferˆandˆhowˆfarˆalongˆitˆis.ˆ##ˆScheduledˆorˆpendingˆACHˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆcancelˆaˆscheduledˆACHˆtransferˆinˆtheˆappˆuntilˆtheˆACHˆcutoffˆtimeˆ(4:00ˆPMˆET)ˆonˆitsˆsendˆdate.ˆTapˆTransfers,ˆchooseˆtheˆtransferˆandˆtapˆCancel.ˆAfterˆtheˆcutoff,ˆtheˆtransferˆisˆalreadyˆonˆitsˆwayˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelled.ˆ##ˆBrookPayˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆarriveˆinstantlyˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelled.ˆ##ˆWiresˆWiresˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆonceˆsent.ˆWeˆcanˆaskˆtheˆreceivingˆbankˆtoˆreturnˆtheˆmoney,ˆbutˆtheˆreceivingˆbankˆdecides,ˆandˆitˆisn'tˆguaranteed.ˆ##ˆRecurringˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆstopˆfutureˆtransfersˆinˆaˆrecurringˆseriesˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆStoppingˆtheˆseriesˆdoesn'tˆcancelˆaˆtransferˆthat'sˆalreadyˆpastˆitsˆcutoff.ˆ##ˆSentˆtoˆtheˆwrongˆaccount?ˆIfˆanˆACHˆtransferˆwentˆtoˆtheˆwrongˆexternalˆaccount,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆWe'llˆtryˆtoˆcontactˆtheˆotherˆbank,ˆbutˆweˆcan'tˆpromiseˆtheˆmoneyˆcomesˆback.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="disputes-ach">
DisputingˆanˆACHˆdebitˆAnˆACHˆdebitˆisˆwhenˆaˆcompanyˆpullsˆmoneyˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆusingˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumber,ˆforˆexampleˆaˆutilityˆbillˆorˆaˆloanˆpayment.ˆ##ˆUnauthorizedˆACHˆdebitsˆIfˆaˆcompanyˆtookˆmoneyˆyouˆdidn'tˆauthorize,ˆreportˆitˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆitˆfirstˆappearedˆon.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆIˆdidn'tˆauthorizeˆthis.ˆ##ˆAuthorized,ˆbutˆwrongˆIfˆyouˆdidˆauthorizeˆtheˆcompanyˆbutˆtheˆamountˆorˆdateˆisˆwrong,ˆcontactˆtheˆcompanyˆfirst.ˆIfˆthatˆdoesn'tˆwork,ˆmessageˆsupportˆandˆwe'llˆlookˆatˆitˆwithˆyou.ˆ##ˆStoppingˆfutureˆdebitsˆYouˆcanˆblockˆaˆcompanyˆfromˆpullingˆmoneyˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆBlockˆfutureˆdebits.ˆTellˆtheˆcompanyˆtoo,ˆsoˆtheyˆknowˆtoˆbillˆyouˆanotherˆway.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆWe'llˆaskˆtheˆcompany'sˆbankˆtoˆreturnˆtheˆmoney.ˆIfˆyourˆclaimˆpassesˆanˆinitialˆreview,ˆyouˆgetˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆACHˆtransfersˆyouˆsentˆyourself,ˆandˆBrookPayˆpayments,ˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputedˆthisˆway.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
